title: Bethe ansatz solution to integrable bosonic cube networks
summary: We study two extended Bose-Hubbard-type Hamiltonians representing bosonic networks restricted to the graph of a cube. For both Hamiltonians, we demonstrate that Bethe ansatz methods of solution can be employed after applying a canonical transformation of operators. We provide the resulting Bethe ansatz equations, and corresponding formulae for states and energies of both Hamiltonians.
